典型抗精神病药也和微生物变化有关。 因此，了解药物对肠道菌群的作用机制是很有必要的 。
人体的胃肠道，尤其是结肠中，富集着数以亿万计的肠道菌群，这些微生物所编码的基因组是人体本身基因的

most common epigenetic modifications and plays a key role in chromatin remodeling and gene expression regulation． Studies have shown that changes in the sites and levels of histone acetylation are observed during liver fibrosis． Histone acetylation is regulated by histone acetyltransferase ( HAT ) and histone deacetylase ( HDAC) ． Imbalance of HAT and HDAC can cause pathojulogical changes． Many studies have investigated the role of HAT and HDAC in the initiation and progression of liver fi-brosis． This article reviews the recent research on histone acetylation in liver fibrosis in order to provide new perspectives and targets for the pathological mechanism of liver fibrosis and the development of related therapeutic drugs．Key words: histone acetylation; liver fibrosis; hepatic stellate cells; histone acetyltransferase; histone deacetylase; histone deacetylase inhibitor对人体无害的，其种类、数量以及分布通常处于一种稳态，这种自发的稳态形成了对病原菌一定的抵御能力，在维持人体健康以及发挥正常生理功能中发挥着重要作用。 抗生素类药物会造成肠道菌群的失衡，且不同抗生素不同的作用机理使其在作用于人体复杂的生态系统后，对肠道菌群组成产生的影响不尽相同。
